leadingCandidates.summary: Epoch 2 of 8: Non-Invasive ALSA Hardware Discovery (Peak MIDI 1 hw:3,0,0, UMC1820 hw:0,0,0, nanoKONTROL2 hw:2,0,0), Safety Clamping, NRPN/Dual-CC Router & Bidirectional OSC Server (Target: crates/synth-midi-osc; Related: src/midi.rs, src/hardware_verify.rs). Implement read-only /proc/asound/cards and /proc/asound/seq/clients inspection in crates/synth-midi-osc and src/hardware_verify.rs detecting Focusrite A.E Peak (Peak MIDI 1, hw:3,0,0, client 28, USB ID 1235:007e), UMC1820 MIDI 1 (hw:0,0,0, client 16), and Korg nanoKONTROL2 (hw:2,0,0, client 24) with safe virtual loopback default (never sending unprompted MIDI bytes to hw:3,0,0 or hw:0,0,0 during tests). Implement Novation Peak MIDI Channel 1 router (7-bit CC, +32 bipolar dual-CC, 14-bit NRPN, Bank Select CC0/CC32 + Program Change, and Focusrite/Novation 00 20 29 SysEx patch dump codec), self-oscillation/overdrive safety clamp (safe_sweep_range on CCs 29, 36, 79, 80, 104, 110), and bidirectional UDP OSC server (/peak/osc/{1..3}/*, /peak/filter/*, /peak/env/*, /peak/lfo/*, /peak/fx/*, /peak/animate/{1,2}, /peak/panic) with unit tests. Ensure all workspace tests pass (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --workspace and npm test). Write reports/report-002.md and compile it with /home/renick/claude/html-report-generator/build-report.sh --pdf.

Epoch 4 of 8: 3x ADSR Envelopes, Dual Tempo-Synced LFOs, 16-Slot Mod Matrix + 4-Slot FX Matrix, Animate 1/2 Macros, Arpeggiator & Master FX Chain (Target: src/peak_mod_fx.rs; Related: src/lib.rs, src/peak_synth.rs). Implement the complete Novation Peak modulation and effects engine in src/peak_mod_fx.rs and wire into src/lib.rs: 3 ADSR envelopes (Amp CC86-89, Mod 1 CC90-93, Mod 2 CC94/95/117/103 with deterministic ADSR curve generator), 2 LFOs (Rate CC30/31, Sync Rate CC81/84, Fade CC82/85, Range CC83, LFO->Pitch/Shape/Filter depths), 16-slot dual-source Modulation Matrix (Source A x Source B -> Destination with bipolar depth -64..+63) + 4-slot FX Mod Matrix, Animate 1 & 2 performance macro buttons (CC114/CC115) with live parameter offset preview, Arpeggiator gate/clock (CC116) & Glide (CC5/CC35), and Master FX chain (Analogue Distortion CC104, 3-mode Chorus CC105/107/118, Sync Delay CC108/109/110, 3-type Reverb CC112/113) with unit tests. Ensure all workspace tests pass (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --workspace and npm test). Write reports/report-004.md and compile it with /home/renick/claude/html-report-generator/build-report.sh --pdf.

leadingCandidates.summary: Epoch 3 of 8: Novation Peak 8-Voice FPGA NCO Oscillator, 17-Wavetable, Ring/Noise Mixer & Analogue State-Variable Filter Domain Engine (Target: src/peak_synth.rs; Related: src/lib.rs, crates/synth-core). Implement the core 8-voice Novation Peak synthesis domain engine in src/peak_synth.rs and export in src/lib.rs, backed directly by synth_core::SynthPatch and synth_core::CommandHistory (zero duplicate wrapper or undo structs). Cover all 3 FPGA NCO oscillators per voice (Range CC3/37/65, Coarse CC14/17/20, Fine CC15/18/21, Shape/Wavetable interpolation CC12/39/71 across 17 wavetables x 5 waves, VSync CC34/42/44, Mod Env/LFO depth CCs, deterministic harmonic spectrum & wavetable slice calculator, voice divergence/drift), Mixer (Osc 1/2/3 levels CC23/24/25, Ring Mod 1x2 CC26, Noise mix CC27), and Analogue State-Variable Filter (12dB/24dB LP/BP/HP response curve calculator, Cutoff CC29, Key Tracking CC75, Osc 3 -> Filter FM CC76, Mod Env 1 -> Filter CC78, Resonance CC79, Pre-Filter Overdrive CC80, Post-Filter Drive CC36) with unit tests. Ensure all workspace tests pass (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --workspace and npm test). Write reports/report-003.md and compile it with /home/renick/claude/html-report-generator/build-report.sh --pdf.

Implement src/peak_librarian.rs reusing synth_core::PresetLibrary, PatchDiff, Randomizer, and SoftTakeoverState directly: 8 curated Novation Peak factory patches (Init Patch, Oxford FPGA Pad, Acid Overdrive Bass, VSync Lead, Ring Mod Bell, Lush Chorus Strings, Dub Delay Chord, Animate Morph Arp), 4 banks x 128 patches (Banks A..D via CC0/CC32 + Program Change), SysEx single-patch and bank dump state machine with checksum verification, continuous A..B patch morphing (0.0..=1.0), lock-shielded randomizer (Global, Section-Scoped for Osc/Filter/Env/LFO/FX, and Gaussian Drift with automatic safety caps on CCs 36/79/80/104/110), and Korg nanoKONTROL2 (hw:2,0,0) 8-column fader/knob/button surface mapper with Jump/Catch/Pickup soft takeover and Animate 1/2 triggers. Ensure all workspace tests pass (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --workspace and npm test).
